# CONV-PROVIDERS — provider/plugin/tool runtime: the native C++ capability
# provider SDK (contracts, registry, typed invocation, containment) plus the
# built-in factor-stats and map-thumbnail providers. Qt-free, Python-free;
# links Pwb::Domain for ordered JSON; builtins link the real mapping kernels
# (Pwb::MappingKernel, Pwb::MappingDocument). Frozen against
# provider_oracle.json (generated by tools/oracle/generate_provider_fixtures.py).

add_library(pwb_providers STATIC
    src/contracts.cpp
    src/context.cpp
    src/errors.cpp
    src/execution.cpp
    src/refs.cpp
    src/registry.cpp
    src/schema.cpp
    src/service.cpp
    src/builtin.cpp
    src/builtin_factor_stats.cpp
    src/builtin_map_thumbnail.cpp
    src/png_writer.cpp
    # CPP-CLOSE-10: dynamic plugin boundary + loader (versioned C ABI,
    # capability negotiation, refcounted deferred unload).
    src/plugin_loader.cpp
)
add_library(Pwb::Providers ALIAS pwb_providers)
set_target_properties(pwb_providers PROPERTIES
    EXPORT_NAME Providers
    OUTPUT_NAME pwb-providers
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
)
target_compile_features(pwb_providers PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(pwb_providers PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
# PUBLIC: the SDK headers expose pwb::domain::Json types.
target_link_libraries(pwb_providers PUBLIC Pwb::Domain)
# Builtin providers render/serialize against the real mapping kernels.
target_link_libraries(pwb_providers PUBLIC
    Pwb::MappingKernel
    Pwb::MappingDocument
)
# dlopen/dlsym for the plugin loader (empty on platforms with them in libc).
target_link_libraries(pwb_providers PUBLIC ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})

# CPP-CLOSE-10 — plugin-side authoring glue (error envelopes). A tiny static
# lib so third-party MODULEs link only this + Pwb::Domain headers instead of
# the full provider SDK (whose builtin dependencies are not all PIC).
add_library(pwb_plugin_glue STATIC src/plugin_module_glue.cpp)
add_library(Pwb::PluginGlue ALIAS pwb_plugin_glue)
target_compile_features(pwb_plugin_glue PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(pwb_plugin_glue PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(pwb_plugin_glue PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
target_link_libraries(pwb_plugin_glue PUBLIC Pwb::Domain)

if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_subdirectory(providers_tests)
endif()
